decisions.reason: As a GIS solution platform, it appears strategically central and publicly committed, so management is likely to continue backing it and interpret any weak traction as temporary.

This is a substantial standalone software product with visible market presence since launch, and the firm is likely to persist because of sunk development effort and fit with its GIS-focused offering.

Although more peripheral than a full platform and therefore somewhat easier to discontinue, the version update and dedicated product presence suggest enough prior investment and commitment for management to keep it for now.
